Skill `expo-skill-feedback`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `submit_feedback` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `allowlisted_internet`; adds `feedback_submitted`.
Tool `submit_eval_feedback` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `allowlisted_internet`; requires `user_approved_submission`; adds `eval_submission_attempted`.
Tool `submit_eval_feedback_fallback` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `allowlisted_internet`; requires `user_approved_submission` and `eval_category_rejected`; adds `feedback_submitted`.
Tool `check_eval_category_error` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; needs `allowlisted_internet`; requires `eval_submission_attempted`; adds `eval_category_rejected`.
Tool `telemetry_on` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `user_requested_enable_telemetry`; adds `telemetry_enabled`; removes `telemetry_disabled`.
Tool `telemetry_off` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `user_requested_disable_telemetry`; adds `telemetry_disabled`; removes `telemetry_enabled`.
Tool `telemetry_status` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; adds `telemetry_status_checked`.
Initially true: `telemetry_disabled`.
Goal: any of (`feedback_submitted`, `telemetry_enabled`, `telemetry_disabled`, `telemetry_status_checked`).
Protocol:
  - `user` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `submit_general_feedback`:
      - `agent` uses `submit_feedback`.
    - branch `submit_eval_candidate`:
      - `user` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `approve`:
          - `agent` uses `submit_eval_feedback`.
          - `user` chooses one of (observed):
            - branch `fallback_needed`:
              - `agent` uses `check_eval_category_error`.
              - `agent` uses `submit_eval_feedback_fallback`.
            - branch `no_fallback`: none.
        - branch `decline`: none.
    - branch `enable_telemetry`:
      - `agent` uses `telemetry_on`.
    - branch `disable_telemetry`:
      - `agent` uses `telemetry_off`.
    - branch `check_telemetry_status`:
      - `agent` uses `telemetry_status`.
    - branch `understand_telemetry`: none.
